description: This is a 3D model of three identical white desk lamps, arranged in a horizontal line against a plain light gray background. Each lamp features a classic dome-shaped shade with vertical slatted detailing on the exterior. The shade is attached to a slender, articulated arm that extends downwards and then bends to the side. A chain mechanism is visible, running along the arm, suggesting adjustability. The base of the lamp is not fully visible, but the overall design points to a functional task lighting solution, often seen in offices, study rooms, or creative spaces.
